There's no tool to set a limit. There's get_flight_cost, get_credit_card_balance, etc. There's no tool to set a limit. So we cannot do that. We can ask clarifying question: "Which system or tool do you want to set the limit in?" Or "Do you want to set a limit in the travel system?" The user didn't specify. So we need to ask clarifying question.
